name: unifi
description: UniFi: fills live addresses with the clients of UniFi networks and Wi-Fi networks, and shows which switch port or access point each device is on. Read-only: it never changes the controller.

url.description: the UniFi console, such as https://192.168.1.2 (Cloud Key, Dream Machine) or https://unifi.lan:8443 (self-hosted Network application)

api_key.description: a local API key: UniFi Network on the console, Settings → Control Plane → Integrations (keys from unifi.ui.com don't work locally)

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the console's certificate (for its self-signed one), such as AB:CD:...

ca.description: or: the CA certificate (PEM) that signed it; with neither, the system's CAs

site.description: the site's short name, as in the console's address bar (default: default)

network_objects.description: object=network, such as iot=IoT: the clients on that UniFi network go into that object

ssid_objects.description: object=SSID, such as guests=Home Guest: the clients on that Wi-Fi network go into that object

interval_seconds.description: how often the clients are read
